title: Middle Eastern Shakshuka
description: A flavorful North African dish where eggs are poached in a spicy tomato sauce. Serve with crusty bread or pita for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: middle eastern shakshuka spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a claypot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shakshuka spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Make 4 wells in the tomato mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the claypot to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
